findings.detail: This leaf groups detected mass traces into isotope features and charge estimates but does not extract per-metabolite isotopologue distributions from the stage's feature table.
This leaf consumes already measured isotopologue profiles to calculate model-predicted intensities and does not extract distributions from an LC-MS feature table.
This leaf compares two NMR-derived isotopomer distributions for agreement rather than computing LC-MS mass-isotopomer distributions and fractional enrichment.
This leaf only normalises raw isotopologue areas within each metabolite and explicitly does not correct natural isotope abundance.
This leaf integrates isotopologues from raw GC-CI-MS data but does not correct an LC-MS isotopologue distribution for natural abundance and tracer purity.
This leaf aligns and integrates targeted isotopologue EICs that were already extracted, so it does not produce the requested all-isotopologue feature table from raw LC-MS.
This leaf renders a stacked-bar labelling figure from a pre-existing table and does not produce the requested consolidated tracing report table.
This leaf creates a general human-facing HTML metabolomics report rather than a machine-readable stable-isotope labelling and enrichment table.
